test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘ACUTE’ is written as ‘EXAYI’, and ‘SPEND’ is written as ‘XUISW’. How will ‘BLAME’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73cff0d1b9be3ebfa5c4e9f2ed0eb896c060f1a4198081fe0c91cb375fae30ab.png] 

**Logic:**

 
• **Vowel coded as next vowel i.e. A coded as E, E coded as I and go on.**
 
• **__Code of consonant :__**

 
• ** Sigle digit position value = opposite letter **
 
• ** double digit = position value + 5**

​ ‘ACUTE’ → ‘EXAYI’

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53b79cda16727f2453aa6eb4f359a9b266a95a0122a9405ac10e7785701939a0.png] ​

And

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c30e72446555fd4c36a6e7f9aa31807901774dacefb081114ca91b70dd1f9ed9.png] 

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34251629d56372cc05f6f50a7d04a1bfbf6046c25aa3467915753aa39447b4ac.png] ​

Hence, the correct answer is **"YQERI**".
